backend/main.mo: Backend actor implementing admin auth, logo and AdMob config storage, and user session/profile management using maps and access control mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds a new optional logo field while preserving existing AdMob config, sessions, and user profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend source files describing their roles in routing, UI, hooks, and admin features.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme definitions using OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Frontend documentation covering setup, admin access flow, panel features, and production SPA routing notes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with pathname routing, header logo display, admin navigation, and conditional rendering of VPN vs admin panels.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Handles auth flow, loading state, and profile setup UI before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/RewardedAdStubMo: Simulates a rewarded video ad with progress, play state, and completion/cancel events.
Displays VPN session status and unlock flow using rewarded ads, with active/locked/expired states.
frontend/src/config/admob.ts: Contains placeholder AdMob configuration and guidelines for real-world integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminPanel.ts: Provides queries to check admin status and fetch admin overview using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppAdMobConfig.ts: Fetches and updates remotely stored AdMob configuration via actor queries and mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppLogo.ts: Fetches and uploads the app logo using actor-based queries and mutations.
Clears user VPN sessions and refreshes session status via a mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionStatus.ts: Fetches session status, computes whether a session is active or expired, and exposes timing data with auto‑refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnlockSession.ts: Mutation hook that triggers session unlocking and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and UI tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page handling admin checks, AdMob config editing, logo uploads, and displaying overview data.
frontend/src/utils/timeFormat.ts: Utility to format seconds into HH:MM:SS strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session storage values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, including existing admin-panel features, pending feature requests, and architectural notes for building admin routes and configuration UIs. Captures versioning, known issues, and overall project metadata for development planning.
